events.title: Demo Update Now Live! 🌿 Community Feedback Changes
events.summary: 🌿 Littlelands Demo Update is Live! Hey all! We’ve been absolutely thrilled by the response to the Littlelands demo so far. Thank you so much for playing, sharing screenshots, reporting bugs, and leaving feedback. 💛 Today we’re rolling out a new demo update featuring several community-requested improvements and fixes! Control Improvements One of the biggest pieces of feedback we received was around the default mouse & keyboard controls, especially keeping important actions closer to the WASD keys

events.title: Demo Out Now! 🌿 Your Cozy Adventure Begins
events.summary: 🌿 The Littlelands Demo is Out Now! ✨Your cozy adventure begins today.Step into Littlelands, a charming world filled with big-hearted characters, lush landscapes, and peaceful moments waiting to be discovered. Whether you’re exploring hidden caves, chatting with quirky locals, or simply watching the sunset, Littlelands is yours to enjoy at your own pace.🧭 What’s in the Demo?• ~2 hours of gameplay • Custom character creation • 6 unique areas to explore • 20+ NPCs to meet and help • Multiple shops

events.title: A Sneak Peak Into Littlelands
events.summary: As premiered on #IGNLive: We hope that you enjoy our sneak peek gameplay overview that we had prepared for #IGNLive. It's beyond cool to have our title featured in 2 Summer Games Fest Showcases. Dive deep into the adorable world of Littlelands, a charming and colorful diorama-style wonderland brimming with secrets.
